## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

| $`\mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{sto}}`$ | `snapshot_weightings_stores` over $`\mathcal{T}`$ — PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.stores` — hours a snapshot weighs in a storage balance |

#### Conditions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_curve` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: one of PyPSA's `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`) |
| $`\mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}`$ | `StorageUnit_fix` over $`\mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — a storage unit with a fixed build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `fix` rows |

#### Variables

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`C^{\mathrm{curve}}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along a curve, held above the curve |
| $`p`$ | `Generator_p` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot |
| $`s`$ | `Line_s` over $`\mathcal{K} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Line-s` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Line_bus0` end: a positive value withdraws there and injects at `Line_bus1`, lossless |
| $`f`$ | `Link_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Link-p` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value withdraws there and injects at every bus the link's output ports deliver to |
| $`z`$ | `Process_p` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Process-p` — PyPSA's internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive |
| $`h^{+}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_dispatch` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus |
| $`h^{-}`$ | `StorageUnit_p_store` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge |
| $`\mathit{soc}`$ | `StorageUnit_state_of_charge` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — `StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot |
| $`\sigma`$ | `Transformer_s` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{M}`$ — `Transformer-s` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Transformer_bus0` end: a positive value withdraws there and injects at `Transformer_bus1`, lossless |

#### Definitions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathit{Bus\_injection}`$ | `Bus_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side |
| $`\mathit{Cycle\_angle\_sum}`$ | `Cycle_angle_sum` over $`\mathcal{C} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — the voltage angle differences around a cycle: every branch flow times its cycle weight, and every transformer phase shift |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_injection}`$ | `Generator_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_opex}`$ | `Generator_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_primary\_energy}`$ | `Generator_primary_energy` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}`$ | `Generator_running_cost` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a generator's output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`) |
| $`\mathrm{GlobalConstraint\_energy\_weight}`$ | `GlobalConstraint_energy_weight` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what one unit of power at a snapshot counts for in a row. Where the row counts the snapshot, it is the generator weighting times the years of the snapshot's period. Where it does not, it is nothing |
| $`\mathit{Line\_angle\_sum}`$ | `Line_angle_sum` over $`\mathcal{C} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Line\_injection}`$ | `Line_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_injection}`$ | `Link_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_opex}`$ | `Process_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}`$ | `StorageUnit_charge_carried_in` over $`\Xi \times \mathcal{T} \times \mathcal{S}`$ — the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}`$ | `StorageUnit_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}`$ | `StorageUnit_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Transformer\_angle\_sum}`$ | `Transformer_angle_sum` over $`\mathcal{C} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Transformer\_injection}`$ | `Transformer_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{primary\_energy}`$ | `primary_energy` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi`$ — what a `primary_energy` row totals: weighted generator energy over the snapshots it counts, less the charge left in weighted storage at the close. The initial charge it is compared against is folded into the row's constant |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |
| $`\mathrm{pos}(t)`$ | `position()` — the position of $`t`$, counted from $`0`$; $`t`$ is the label |
| $`\mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{relation}(t)}(t)`$ | `position(within=relation[...])` — the position of $`t`$ inside its group |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix`**

```math
\mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s} \iff \neg \mathrm{ext}^{h}_{s} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s} \qquad \forall\, t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Line_s`**

```math
s_{k,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, k \in \mathcal{K},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{s}_{k,t}
```

**`Link_p`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Process_p`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`StorageUnit_p_dispatch`**

```math
h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_p_store`**

```math
h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_state_of_charge`**

```math
\mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`Transformer_s`**

```math
\sigma_{\xi,t,m} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ m \in \mathcal{M} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{\sigma}_{t,m}
```

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Line\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Transformer\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Cycle_angle_sum`**

```math
\mathit{Cycle\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} = \mathit{Line\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} + \mathit{Transformer\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, c \in \mathcal{C},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_primary_energy`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_primary\_energy}_{l,\xi} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{GlobalConstraint\_energy\_weight}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{a}_{g,l,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`GlobalConstraint_energy_weight`**

```math
\mathrm{GlobalConstraint\_energy\_weight}_{l,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{gen}}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{yr}}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} & \text{if } \mathrm{in}_{l,\xi,t} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Line_angle_sum`**

```math
\mathit{Line\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} = \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} s_{k,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{x}_{c,k,\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, c \in \mathcal{C},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Line_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Line\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K} \,:\, \mathrm{Line\_bus0}(k) = n} s_{k,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K} \,:\, \mathrm{Line\_bus1}(k) = n} s_{k,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_bus0}(l) = n} f_{l,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}(o) = n} \mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,(2)}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{f}_{o} \\ f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, o \in \mathcal{O},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_demand`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{sgn}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \cdot \mathrm{load}_{d,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{on}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, d \in \mathcal{D},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_injection`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D} \,:\, \mathrm{Load\_bus}(d) = n} \mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}(r) = n} \mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,(2)}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{z}_{r} \\ z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, r \in \mathcal{R},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`StorageUnit_charge_carried_in`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}_{\xi,t,s} = \begin{cases} \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,\left( t \ominus \mathrm{idle} \right) \ominus 1,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}_{t,s} \right) \\ \mathrm{soc}^{0}_{\xi,s} & \text{if } \neg \mathrm{cyc}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \left( \mathrm{pos}(t) = 0 \vee \mathrm{open}_{t,s} \right) \\ \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} 1,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \\ \mathrm{soc}^{0}_{\xi,s} & \text{if } \mathrm{reset}_{\xi,s} \wedge \neg \mathrm{cyc}^{y}_{\xi,s} \wedge \mathrm{pos}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}(t) = 0 \\ \rho_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t - 1,s} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S}
```

**`StorageUnit_injection`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_bus}(s) = n} \mathrm{sgn}^{h}_{s} \cdot \left( h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} - h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \right) \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`StorageUnit_opex`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{h}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{h,(2)}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{soc}}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Transformer_angle_sum`**

```math
\mathit{Transformer\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} = \sum_{m \in \mathcal{M}} \sigma_{\xi,t,m} \cdot \mathrm{x}^{\sigma}_{c,\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t),m} + \sum_{m \in \mathcal{M}} \vartheta_{c,\xi,t,m} \qquad \forall\, c \in \mathcal{C},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Transformer_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Transformer\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{m \in \mathcal{M} \,:\, \mathrm{Transformer\_bus0}(m) = n} \sigma_{\xi,t,m} \right) + \sum_{m \in \mathcal{M} \,:\, \mathrm{Transformer\_bus1}(m) = n} \sigma_{\xi,t,m} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`primary_energy`**

```math
\mathit{primary\_energy}_{l,\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_primary\_energy}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi
```

**`risk_weighted_opex`**

```math
\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot \mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi}
```

**`scenario_opex`**

```math
\mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{StorageUnit\_opex}_{\xi} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`total_cost`**

```math
\mathit{total\_cost} = \mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}
```

#### Objective

```math
\min \mathit{total\_cost}
```

#### Subject to

**`Bus_nodal_balance`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Bus\_attached}_{n,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`GlobalConstraint_primary_energy_ub`**

```math
\mathit{primary\_energy}_{l,\xi} \le \mathrm{K}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{type}_{l} = \text{'}\mathrm{primary\_energy}\text{'} \wedge \mathrm{sense}_{l,\xi} = \text{'}\mathrm{<=}\text{'}
```

**`Kirchhoff_Voltage_Law`**

```math
\mathit{Cycle\_angle\_sum}_{c,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, c \in \mathcal{C},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Cycle\_in\_basis}_{c,\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)}
```

**`Line_fix_s_lower`**

```math
s_{k,\xi,t} \ge -\overline{\mathrm{s}}_{k,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{s}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{k,\xi} \qquad \forall\, k \in \mathcal{K},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{s}_{k} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{s}_{k,t}
```

**`Line_fix_s_upper`**

```math
s_{k,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{s}}_{k,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{s}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{k,\xi} \qquad \forall\, k \in \mathcal{K},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{s}_{k} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{s}_{k,t}
```

**`Link_fix_p_lower`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{f}}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_fix_p_upper`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{f}}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Process_fix_p_lower`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{z}}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{j,\xi} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_fix_p_upper`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{z}}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{j,\xi} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`StorageUnit_energy_balance`**

```math
\mathit{StorageUnit\_charge\_carried\_in}_{\xi,t,s} + \eta^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{sto}}_{t} - \frac{h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{sto}}_{t}}{\eta^{+}_{\xi,t,s}} + \mathrm{inflow}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{\mathrm{sto}}_{t} = \mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{h}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_lower`**

```math
h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_upper`**

```math
h^{+}_{\xi,t,s} \le \overline{\mathrm{h}}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{h}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{\xi,s} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_p_store_lower`**

```math
h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_p_store_upper`**

```math
h^{-}_{\xi,t,s} \le -\underline{\mathrm{h}}_{\xi,t,s} \cdot \mathrm{h}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{\xi,s} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_lower`**

```math
\mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_upper`**

```math
\mathit{soc}_{\xi,t,s} \le \mathrm{T}^{h}_{\xi,s} \cdot \mathrm{h}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{\xi,s} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ s \in \mathcal{S} \,:\, \mathrm{StorageUnit\_fix}_{t,s}
```

**`Transformer_fix_s_lower`**

```math
\sigma_{\xi,t,m} \ge -\overline{\sigma}_{\xi,t,m} \cdot \sigma^{\mathrm{nom}}_{\xi,m} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ m \in \mathcal{M} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{\sigma}_{m} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{\sigma}_{t,m}
```

**`Transformer_fix_s_upper`**

```math
\sigma_{\xi,t,m} \le \overline{\sigma}_{\xi,t,m} \cdot \sigma^{\mathrm{nom}}_{\xi,m} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T},\ m \in \mathcal{M} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}^{\sigma}_{m} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{\sigma}_{t,m}
```

    ```yaml
    version: 0
    description: The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods`
      keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the
      future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen
      once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build
      year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced
      at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one
      scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard
      one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage
      factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.
    dimensions:
      breakpoint: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: 'the corners of a piecewise-linear curve, in order.
          A curve runs over the breakpoints its data has rows for, so curves may differ in length'}
      bus: {description: network nodes}
      cycle: {description: 'independent cycles of the passive network graph, the cycle basis, data prep. Each
          period has its own basis, of the branches that are active in it. A label is a position in that period''s
          basis, so one label is a different cycle in another period'}
      generator: {description: 'generating units, each on one bus'}
      global_constraint: {description: 'PyPSA''s `GlobalConstraint` rows, one label per declared limit'}
      line: {description: 'passive branches, each between two buses, their flow set by impedance'}
      link: {description: 'controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to'}
      link_output: {description: 'a link''s output ports, one label per port a link declares. The labels are
          PyPSA''s `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns read long, data prep. A link of any number of output ports is
          then one term in the balance'}
      load: {description: 'demands, each on one bus'}
      period: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: investment periods. It is PyPSA's `investment_periods`}
      process: {description: 'generalised multi-port converters, each with an internal power that every port
          draws or delivers at its own rate'}
      process_output: {description: 'a process''s ports, one label per port a process declares. The labels
          are PyPSA''s `bus0`, `bus1`, …, each with a signed `rate`, data prep. A process of any number of
          ports is then one term in the balance'}
      scenario: {description: 'the futures dispatch is chosen in, each with a weight'}
      snapshot: {dtype: datetime, ordered: true, description: dispatch periods}
      storage_unit: {description: 'storage units, dispatch and store behind one bus connection'}
      transformer: {description: 'passive branches between two buses, their flow set by impedance and tap

      Process_output_process: {key: process_output, values: process, description: the process a port belongs

      StorageUnit_bus: {key: storage_unit, values: bus, description: the bus a storage unit sits on}
      Transformer_bus0: {key: transformer, values: bus, description: the bus a transformer's flow is measured

      Transformer_bus1: {key: transformer, values: bus, description: the bus at a transformer's other end}

        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.generators` — hours a snapshot weighs in an energy total
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
      snapshot_weightings_stores:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.stores` — hours a snapshot weighs in a storage balance
    variables:
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Line_s:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Line_active
        description: '`Line-s` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Line_bus0` end: a positive value
          withdraws there and injects at `Line_bus1`, lossless'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      StorageUnit_p_dispatch:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_dispatch` — power delivered to the bus'
      StorageUnit_p_store:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-p_store` — power drawn from the bus into charge'
      StorageUnit_state_of_charge:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        description: '`StorageUnit-state_of_charge` — energy held at the end of a snapshot'
      Transformer_s:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: Transformer_active
        description: '`Transformer-s` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Transformer_bus0` end: a
          positive value withdraws there and injects at `Transformer_bus1`, lossless'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      GlobalConstraint_primary_energy_ub:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        where: GlobalConstraint_type == 'primary_energy' AND GlobalConstraint_sense == '<='
        expression: primary_energy <= GlobalConstraint_constant
        description: '`primary_energy` — its total, at most its constant'
      Kirchhoff_Voltage_Law:
        dims: [cycle, scenario, snapshot]
        where: at(Cycle_in_basis, by=snapshot_period[period])
        expression: Cycle_angle_sum == 0
        description: '`Kirchhoff-Voltage-Law` — around every independent cycle the impedance-weighted flows
          sum to nothing. This makes the linear power flow physical rather than transport. A transformer''s
          flow weighs its effective reactance, and its phase shift enters the cycle sum too. The shift is
          a constant where it is fixed. Where a phase-shifting transformer chooses its shift, it is the shift
          decision times its cycle weight. A snapshot uses the cycles of its own period, of the branches that
          are active in it (`constraints.py:1710-1729`). A cycle label that period''s basis does not reach
          has no row'
      Line_fix_s_lower:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active
        expression: Line_s >= (-Line_s_max_pu) * Line_s_nom
        description: '`Line-fix-s-lower` — a fixed line carries at least the negative of its rating, the loss
          counted against it'
      Line_fix_s_upper:
        dims: [line, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Line_s_nom_extendable AND Line_active
        expression: Line_s <= Line_s_max_pu * Line_s_nom
        description: '`Line-fix-s-upper` — a fixed line carries at most its rating, the loss included'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      Process_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p >= Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom
        description: '`Process-fix-p-lower` — a fixed process runs at least its minimum, negative for the
          other way'
      Process_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom
        description: '`Process-fix-p-upper` — a fixed process runs at most its nominal power'
      StorageUnit_energy_balance:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_active
        expression: ((StorageUnit_charge_carried_in + ((StorageUnit_efficiency_store * StorageUnit_p_store)
          * snapshot_weightings_stores)) - ((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * snapshot_weightings_stores) / StorageUnit_efficiency_dispatch))
          + (StorageUnit_inflow * snapshot_weightings_stores) == StorageUnit_state_of_charge
        description: '`StorageUnit-energy_balance` — the charge carried in, plus what is stored after its
          efficiency, less what dispatch draws down before its own, plus inflow not spilled'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_dispatch-lower` — dispatch is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_dispatch_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_dispatch <= StorageUnit_p_max_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_dispatch-upper` — a fixed unit dispatches at most its nominal power'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_store_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_store-lower` — storing is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_p_store_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_p_store <= -StorageUnit_p_min_pu * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-p_store-upper` — a fixed unit stores at most its nominal power, the
          minimum-per-unit column carrying that cap negated'
      StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge >= 0
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-state_of_charge-lower` — charge is non-negative'
      StorageUnit_fix_state_of_charge_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        where: StorageUnit_fix
        expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge <= StorageUnit_max_hours * StorageUnit_p_nom
        description: '`StorageUnit-fix-state_of_charge-upper` — a fixed unit holds at most its hours at nominal
          power'
      Transformer_fix_s_lower:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: not Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active
        expression: Transformer_s >= (-Transformer_s_max_pu) * Transformer_s_nom
        description: '`Transformer-fix-s-lower` — a fixed transformer carries at least the negative of its
          rating, the loss counted against it'
      Transformer_fix_s_upper:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, transformer]
        where: not Transformer_s_nom_extendable AND Transformer_active
        expression: Transformer_s <= Transformer_s_max_pu * Transformer_s_nom
        description: '`Transformer-fix-s-upper` — a fixed transformer carries at most its rating, the loss
          included'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: (((((Generator_injection + Line_injection) + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection)
          + StorageUnit_injection) + Transformer_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Cycle_angle_sum:
        dims: [cycle, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: Line_angle_sum + Transformer_angle_sum
        description: 'the voltage angle differences around a cycle: every branch flow times its cycle weight,
          and every transformer phase shift'
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_primary_energy: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_p * GlobalConstraint_energy_weight) * Generator_primary_energy_weight,
          over=snapshot), over=generator)'}
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      GlobalConstraint_energy_weight:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what one unit of power at a snapshot counts for in a row. Where the row counts the snapshot,
          it is the generator weighting times the years of the snapshot's period. Where it does not, it is
          nothing
        cases:
          counted: {when: GlobalConstraint_counts_snapshot, expression: 'snapshot_weightings_generators *
              at(period_weight_years, by=snapshot_period[period])'}
        otherwise: '0'
      Line_angle_sum: {expression: 'sum(Line_s * at(Line_cycle_weight, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=line)'}
      Line_injection: {expression: '(-sum(Line_s, over=line, by=Line_bus0[bus])) + sum(Line_s, over=line,
          by=Line_bus1[bus])'}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_p * Process_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Process_p
          * Process_p) * Process_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      StorageUnit_charge_carried_in:
        dims: [scenario, snapshot, storage_unit]
        description: the charge a unit opens a snapshot with. At the first snapshot it is active in, it is
          its last such snapshot's less standing loss where it is cyclic. Where it is not, it is the given
          initial charge, which no standing loss has touched yet. Otherwise it is the previous snapshot's
          less standing loss. A unit built in a later period opens in that period, and a cyclic one that retires
          closes on its own last snapshot. Per period, the same holds with each investment period as the horizon
        cases:
          cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: 'StorageUnit_retention * shift(shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot,
              offset=1, edge=''wrap''), along=snapshot, offset=StorageUnit_inactive_snapshots, edge=''wrap'')'}
          opening: {when: NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND NOT StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND (position(snapshot) == 0 OR StorageUnit_opens_late),
            expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
          period_cyclic: {when: StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period, expression: 'StorageUnit_retention
              * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])'}
          period_opening: {when: 'StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial_per_period AND NOT StorageUnit_cyclic_state_of_charge_per_period
              AND position(snapshot, within=snapshot_period[period]) == 0', expression: StorageUnit_state_of_charge_initial}
        otherwise: StorageUnit_retention * shift(StorageUnit_state_of_charge, along=snapshot, offset=1)
      StorageUnit_injection: {expression: 'sum(StorageUnit_sign * (StorageUnit_p_dispatch - StorageUnit_p_store),
          over=storage_unit, by=StorageUnit_bus[bus])'}
      StorageUnit_opex: {expression: '(sum(sum(((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot) +
          sum(sum((((StorageUnit_p_dispatch * StorageUnit_p_dispatch) * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit),
          over=snapshot)) + sum(sum(((StorageUnit_state_of_charge * StorageUnit_marginal_cost_storage) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=storage_unit), over=snapshot)'}
      Transformer_angle_sum: {expression: 'sum(Transformer_s * at(Transformer_cycle_weight, by=snapshot_period[period]),
          over=transformer) + sum(Transformer_phase_shift_weight, over=transformer)'}
      Transformer_injection: {expression: '(-sum(Transformer_s, over=transformer, by=Transformer_bus0[bus]))
          + sum(Transformer_s, over=transformer, by=Transformer_bus1[bus])'}
      primary_energy:
        dims: [global_constraint, scenario]
        expression: Generator_primary_energy
        description: 'what a `primary_energy` row totals: weighted generator energy over the snapshots it
          counts, less the charge left in weighted storage at the close. The initial charge it is compared
          against is folded into the row''s constant'
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: ((Generator_opex + Link_opex) + Process_opex) + StorageUnit_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      StorageUnit_fix: {condition: NOT StorageUnit_p_nom_extendable AND StorageUnit_active, description: a
          storage unit with a fixed build that is active in the snapshot's period. It is PyPSA's `fix` rows}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    def _cycle_periods(n: pypsa.Network, multi: bool) -> list[tuple[object, object]]:
        """``(label, investment_period)`` per period PyPSA builds cycles for — every period under ``multi_investment_periods``, else the one with no period, which takes every branch."""
        return [(p, p) for p in period_labels(n)] if multi else [(PLAIN_PERIOD, None)]


    def _cycle_weights(n: pypsa.Network, multi: bool) -> dict[str, object]:
        """The KVL rows PyPSA itself writes, per period and branch — ``n.cycle_matrix(apply_weights=True)``, times the 1e5 PyPSA scales every cycle row by for conditioning.

        Each period has its own basis, of the branches standing in it, so a cycle
        label is a position in its period's basis. A branch whose weight is NaN — an
        extendable one at zero nominal rating, whose per-unit reactance is infinite
        — has no term: linopy drops it.

        A transformer's phase shift enters the same rows: a fixed one as a constant
        in radians at each snapshot of the period, a varying one as the shift
        decision times its cycle sign and π/180. PyPSA builds the basis from the
        first scenario only, and adds a shift only for a transformer that stands;
        a fixed shift of zero adds nothing and has no row.
        """
        n.determine_network_topology()
        n.calculate_dependent_values()
        transformers = first_scenario(n.static('Transformer'))
        varying_ = transformers['phase_shift_min'] < transformers['phase_shift_max']
        dense = get_switchable_as_dense(n, 'Transformer', 'phase_shift').set_axis(timesteps(n), axis=0)
        if dense.columns.nlevels > 1:
            dense = dense.T.groupby(level='name').first().T
        active = active_by_snapshot(n, 'Transformer')
        stamps = pd.Series(period_of(n) if multi else PLAIN_PERIOD, index=timesteps(n))
        rows: dict[str, list[dict]] = {'Line': [], 'Transformer': []}
        shift_rows, decision_rows = [], []
        basis: dict[object, set[str]] = {}
        for label, period in _cycle_periods(n, multi):
            weighted = n.cycle_matrix(investment_period=period, apply_weights=True) * 1e5
            if weighted.empty:
                continue
            basis[label] = {str(cycle) for cycle in weighted.columns}
            for (kind, name), weights in weighted.iterrows():
                rows.setdefault(kind, [])
                rows[kind].extend(
                    {'period': label, DIM[kind]: str(name), 'cycle': str(cycle), 'value': float(w)}
                    for cycle, w in weights.items()
                    if w and not math.isnan(w)
                )
            plain = n.cycle_matrix(investment_period=period, apply_weights=False)
            if 'Transformer' not in plain.index.get_level_values(0):
                continue
            snapshots = stamps.index[stamps.to_numpy() == label]
            for name, signs in plain.loc['Transformer'].iterrows():
                for cycle, sign in signs.items():
                    if not sign:
                        continue
                    if varying_.get(name, False):
                        decision_rows.append(
                            {
                                'period': label,
                                'transformer': str(name),
                                'cycle': str(cycle),
                                'value': sign * math.pi / 180 * 1e5,
                            }
                        )
                        continue
                    shift_rows.extend(
                        {
                            'snapshot': t,
                            'transformer': str(name),
                            'cycle': str(cycle),
                            'value': float(sign) * float(dense.at[t, name]) * math.pi / 180 * 1e5,
                        }
                        for t in snapshots
                        if dense.at[t, name] and active.at[t, name]
                    )
        line = pd.DataFrame(rows['Line'], columns=['period', 'line', 'cycle', 'value']).astype({'value': float})
        transformer = pd.DataFrame(rows['Transformer'], columns=['period', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']).astype(
            {'value': float}
        )
        cycles = list(pd.unique(pd.concat([line['cycle'], transformer['cycle']])))
        return {
            'cycle': pl.Series('cycle', cycles, dtype=pl.String),
            'Cycle_in_basis': pd.DataFrame(
                [
                    {'period': label, 'cycle': cycle, 'value': cycle in basis.get(label, set())}
                    for label, _ in _cycle_periods(n, multi)
                    for cycle in cycles
                ],
                columns=['period', 'cycle', 'value'],
            ).astype({'value': bool}),
            'Line_cycle_weight': line,
            'Transformer_cycle_weight': transformer,
            'Transformer_phase_shift_weight': pd.DataFrame(
                shift_rows, columns=['snapshot', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']
            ).astype({'value': float}),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_cycle_weight': _everywhere(
                pd.DataFrame(decision_rows, columns=['period', 'transformer', 'cycle', 'value']),
                {
                    'period': [label for label, _ in _cycle_periods(n, multi)],
                    'transformer': list(transformers.index.astype(str)),
                    'cycle': cycles,
                },
            ),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_varying': per_component('Transformer', varying_, bool),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_min': per_component('Transformer', transformers['phase_shift_min']),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_max': per_component('Transformer', transformers['phase_shift_max']),
            'Transformer_phase_shift_fixed': long('Transformer', dense),
        }


    def _everywhere(table: pd.DataFrame, labels: dict[str, list]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """*table* with a zero at every combination of *labels* it has no row for — a table the file refuses to find short."""
        product = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(list(labels.values()), names=list(labels)).to_frame(index=False)
        return product.merge(table, on=list(labels), how='left').fillna({'value': 0.0}).astype({'value': float})


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'StorageUnit_bus': relation(n, 'StorageUnit', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_generators': weighting(n, 'generators'),
            **{name: table for component in DISPATCHABLE for name, table in dispatchable(n, component, optimize).items()},
            **ports(n, 'Link'),
            **ports(n, 'Process'),
            **storage(n, multi),
            **branches(n),
            **_cycle_weights(n, multi),
            **losses(n, optimize, outages),
            **security(n, outages, multi),
            **global_constraints(n, multi),
            **flow_based(n),
            **marginal_cost_curve(n),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
        'snapshot_weightings_stores': weighting(n, 'stores'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_60_efficiency_per_snapshot.yaml', sources) as solution:
        solution.objective  # 130562.094184
    ```

=== "PyPSA"

    The network, `rung_60_efficiency_per_snapshot.py` in the corpus — the spine plus what this rung adds:

    ```python
    # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: mathspec Contributors
    #
    # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

    """Rung 60: efficiencies per snapshot — a link, a process, a storage unit, a fuel unit under a primary-energy cap and a transformer with a fixed phase shift, each reading its coefficient per snapshot."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    from datetime import datetime

    #: Four hourly stamps. The `generators` weighting is uniform, as rung 16's, so a
    #: `delay` of one is a shift of one snapshot position. The `objective` and
    #: `stores` columns stay non-uniform, so no cost or storage factor passes as identity.
    SNAPSHOTS = [datetime(2015, 1, 1, hour) for hour in range(4)]
    WEIGHTINGS = {'objective': [2.0, 1.5, 2.5, 3.0], 'stores': [0.5, 2.0, 1.5, 2.5], 'generators': [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}

    LINK_EFFICIENCY = [2.0, 3.5, 2.5, 3.0]
    PROCESS_RATE = [0.9, 0.5, 0.8, 0.6]
    EFFICIENCY_STORE = [0.9, 0.5, 0.9, 0.5]
    EFFICIENCY_DISPATCH = [0.6, 0.9, 0.7, 0.95]
    FUEL_EFFICIENCY = [0.3, 0.6, 0.4, 0.5]
    PHASE_SHIFT = [0.0, 0.5, -0.3, 1.0]


    def build():
        """A source feeding a sink over a delayed link and a delayed process, a storage unit and a capped fuel unit at the sink, and a triangle with a fixed phase shift per snapshot."""
        import pypsa

        n = pypsa.Network()
        n.set_snapshots(SNAPSHOTS)
        for column, values in WEIGHTINGS.items():
            n.snapshot_weightings[column] = values
        n.add('Carrier', 'fuel60', co2_emissions=1.0)
        n.add('Bus', ['source', 'sink'])
        n.add('Generator', 'spring60', bus='source', p_nom=200, marginal_cost=5)
        n.add('Generator', 'backup60', bus='sink', p_nom=200, marginal_cost=100)
        n.add(
            'Generator', 'fuel_unit60', bus='sink', carrier='fuel60', p_nom=40, marginal_cost=20, efficiency=FUEL_EFFICIENCY
        )
        n.add('Link', 'heat_pump60', bus0='source', bus1='sink', p_nom=10, efficiency=LINK_EFFICIENCY, delay=1)
        n.add('Process', 'boiler60', bus0='source', bus1='sink', p_nom=20, rate1=PROCESS_RATE, delay1=1)
        n.add(
            'StorageUnit',
            'battery60',
            bus='sink',
            p_nom=20,
            max_hours=2,
            cyclic_state_of_charge=True,
            efficiency_store=EFFICIENCY_STORE,
            efficiency_dispatch=EFFICIENCY_DISPATCH,
        )
        n.add('Load', 'sink_load60', bus='sink', p_set=[60.0, 90.0, 50.0, 100.0])
        n.add(
            'GlobalConstraint',
            'fuel_cap60',
            type='primary_energy',
            carrier_attribute='co2_emissions',
            sense='<=',
            constant=150,
        )
        n.add('Bus', ['a', 'b', 'c'])
        n.add('Generator', 'hydro60', bus='a', p_nom=300, marginal_cost=10)
        n.add('Generator', 'diesel60', bus='c', p_nom=300, marginal_cost=200)
        n.add('Load', 'town60', bus='c', p_set=[90.0, 75.0, 120.0, 105.0])
        n.add('Line', 'ab60', bus0='a', bus1='b', carrier='AC', x=0.002, r=0.0002, s_nom=120)
        n.add('Line', 'bc60', bus0='b', bus1='c', carrier='AC', x=0.002, r=0.0002, s_nom=120)
        n.add('Transformer', 'ca60', bus0='c', bus1='a', x=0.002, r=0.0002, s_nom=40, phase_shift=PHASE_SHIFT)
        return n
    ```

    ```python
    n = build()
    n.optimize(solver_name='highs')
    n.objective  # 130562.094184
    ```
